title: Financial Advisor
description: Schema describing a financial advisor affiliated with an independent broker-dealer network, such as the Cetera Financial Group (formerly assembled by RCS Capital).

id.description: Unique identifier for the financial advisor record.

crdNumber.description: FINRA Central Registration Depository (CRD) number uniquely identifying the advisor.

firmCrdNumber.description: CRD number of the registered broker-dealer the advisor is affiliated with.

firmName.description: Name of the registered broker-dealer or RIA the advisor operates under.

licenses.description: List of FINRA Series licenses held by the advisor.

designations.description: Professional designations held (e.g., CFP, CFA, ChFC).

assetsUnderManagement.description: Total assets under management or advisement in USD.

registeredSince.description: Date the advisor first registered with FINRA.
